title: [Decision] Click a stage to advance a deal: the capability exists but a default record page cannot turn it on
body:
epic:#26676#1 · zhuangjianguo · session_cdb7a717def74e719988f089fbaa18ff

The maintainer: 「等我决定的都要立卡，并且从业务的角度给我具体解释和我沟通」 (2026-11-04). Measured by the seat on `main` `63b86b385d`, on the example CRM unless noted. No `domain:*` label is set: triage routes this card.

## The question

Moving a deal to the next stage is the most frequent update in a CRM. Today it takes 编辑 → change 阶段 → 更新. The platform can already advance by clicking the stage path, but only on a page that sets `allowStageChange: true` on its path block. A default record page has no block to set it on, and most apps use the default page.

Governing text: #28061 and #28303 (opt-in, off by default), and the 2026-08-23 ruling cited in `record-path.inertReadout.test.tsx`: a click-to-advance control is "a separate card". `packages/spec/src/ui/component.zod.ts:2103`.

## Measured

- CRM opportunity page: the stage segments are read-only. Nothing in `ui/packages/app-shell/src` or `examples` sets the key (`git grep allowStageChange`).
- Saving through the dialog offers only the moves the state machine allows.

## Options

- **A. On by default on the default record page,** for a reader who may edit the field, with a confirmation, judged by the field's validation and state machine. A declared page keeps its own setting.
- **B. A new object-level key** the author turns on.
- **C. Declared pages only,** as today.

## Recommendation: A

## 四轴分析

**实际业务需求。** 销售每天推进商机好几次，每次多点三下，还要打开一个大表单只改一个字段。这是记录页最常用的操作。

**项目长远合理性。** A 不加新键，默认页本来就是平台决定的。按钮之前被定为只读，是因为它「看着能点其实不能」，现在真能点了，那个顾虑就消失了。

**防 AI 写错。** A 没有新键可写错。B 多一个键，AI 容易漏写，功能就悄悄不在。保存仍走同一套校验和状态机，不会绕过规则。

**创业阶段不扩散。** 能力已建成（#28303），只差默认页接上。风险是误点，所以要二次确认。

| 棱 | A | B | C |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| 业务 | 强 | 中 | 弱 |
| 长远 | 强 | 中 | 中 |
| 防错 | 强 | 中 | 强 |
| 不扩散 | 强 | 弱 | 强 |

## Not measured

How a stage move behaves when the move needs another required field. The press refuses in place per #28303; the fill-in path is untested. A reader without edit permission keeps the read-only path, per the code comment.

## Re-check

`git grep -n "allowStageChange" origin/main -- ui/packages/app-shell/src examples`
